note: Searched ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web. The borough's only public GIS service is a cadastral layer set (control points, easements, leases, subdivisions, blocks, parcels) with no zoning district layer. The borough site offers only early-2000s planning and area map PDFs, and the 2025 comprehensive plan update includes no zoning map. Its communities (Igiugig, Kokhanok, Nondalton, Newhalen, Port Alsworth and others) are mostly unincorporated or census-designated places, and none publishes a queryable zoning layer.
